# CG-API-004: Operation deprecation changed

The deprecated flag of an operation was toggled.

**Why it matters:** Deprecation is metadata; it is reported for visibility.

| Attribute | Value |
|---|---|
| Area | [Operations and paths](./#api) |
| Detects | `operation.deprecated` |
| Severity | breaking: high · potentially breaking: medium · undetermined: medium |
| Classification can be overridden | no (the rule only fires when the change is breaking by definition) |

## Message

> Operation {operation} is {state}.
>
> Deprecation does not change the wire contract, but signals a planned removal.
>
> **Fix:** Communicate the timeline to consumers.

## Examples

Each example is an executed test case of the rule (`packages/engine/test/compat/fixtures.ts`).

### Fires: deprecated added

```diff
  openapi: 3.1.0
  info: {title: t, version: v}
  paths:
-   /a: {get: {responses: {'200': {description: ok}}}}
+   /a: {get: {deprecated: true, responses: {'200': {description: ok}}}}
```

**Result:** Informational, info. Operation GET /a is now deprecated.

### Fires: deprecated removed

```diff
  openapi: 3.1.0
  info: {title: t, version: v}
  paths:
-   /a: {get: {deprecated: true, responses: {'200': {description: ok}}}}
+   /a: {get: {responses: {'200': {description: ok}}}}
```

**Result:** Informational, info. Operation GET /a is no longer deprecated.

### Does not fire: unchanged

```diff
  openapi: 3.1.0
  info: {title: t, version: v}
  paths:
    /a: {get: {responses: {'200': {description: ok}}}}
```

**Result:** no finding from this rule.

## Limitations

- Deprecation and Sunset response headers are not interpreted.

## Silence or tune it

```yaml
rules:
  ignore:
    - rule: CG-API-004
      operation: "GET /example"   # optional: narrow it down
      reason: "Explain why this is acceptable"
      expires: 2027-01-01         # optional
  overrides:
    CG-API-004: { severity: low }
```
